node: Travel distribution, hotel connectivity, channel management, revenue management, and payments/fraud back office
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around travel distribution and back-office connectivity with emphasis on underfollowed second-order beneficiaries rather than airlines, hotels, OTAs, or cruise lines. The strongest public mappings found in this pass are: Sabre as the GDS/travel marketplace reference anchor; Agilysys as a hospitality PMS/POS/payments software node; Flywire as a verticalized travel and hospitality payments/workflow platform after Sertifi; and Shift4 as a broader hospitality/leisure payments processor with travel-adjacent cross-border and lodging exposure. PROS would have been a highly relevant airline revenue-management candidate, but it was taken private by Thoma Bravo in December 2025 and is therefore not included as a US-listed candidate.
